dedupe_keys.name: optimal thermal and electric storage capacities for a district cooling system

description: Rama, Miika and colleagues publish this resource through the native repository. A linear-programming application evaluates heat, cooling and electricity storage in an example system with CHP, photovoltaics and compression/absorption chillers. Cooling demand is based on Barcelona solar irradiation and outdoor temperature, and historical Spanish electricity prices enter the optimisation. The model compares storage capacities under resource and cost assumptions using the INDIGO planning tool. This is a modelled system informed by location-specific inputs, not a claimed installed Barcelona network. The public Zenodo description is accessible, while the deposit is restricted and public metadata expose no file inventory or reuse terms. Zenodo publishes the record with restricted access and a native licence label of unknown. Source metadata and file descriptors were inspected; no linked files, model archives, code or documentation bodies were opened. Coverage and validation are limited to the stated model, data or application. Publication date does not establish current software maintenance.
